replication.target_description: Experiment 1: Belgian French-speaking undergraduate participants; Prime versus No-Prime groups; infrared timing of 9.75 m hallway walking after priming, with pre-priming walking speed as a covariate.

n.location: p. 2, Experiment 1, Methods, Participants; p. 3, Experiment 1, Discussion

reported_success.quote: we were unable to replicate the effects

notes: Titles and authors verified against the supplied references. Original locator p. 8 is PDF p. 8, printed p. 237. Original t degrees of freedom are 28 (text extraction OCR renders the final digit as S). Replication prints η² = .01 and F(1, 119) < 1 for the walking-speed test, but no numeric p value or p bound; no p value was inferred. Replication n is the authors’ stated Experiment 1 sample, not a separately tabulated complete-case count; printed test degrees of freedom are retained without correction. Experiment 2 and the original Experiment 2b were not substituted for the assigned studies.
